notes: Fighter class 0x7104f85a70 derives from base 0x7104f6b920 (same size, same slot functions for every export; only +0x190 differs). Layout: two 0x200-byte main-color layers at +0x10 and +0x210 (current descriptor, enabled flag, link id, target, start, frames, counter); four 0x70-byte channels: flash 0/1 at +0x410/+0x480 and burn 0/1 at +0x4F0/+0x560, the export's bool selecting channel 1 (address + 0x70); then misc state +0x5D0..+0x61F. Only get_status is a plain-load export getter; every other field is named from setters (probable). set_main_color's bool scales the color by a rodata constant and also sets the add color and two floats; cancel_main_color passes a white (255) descriptor with the given frames. Per-frame passes f_71003f4560 / f_71003f4a00 consume the channels (not read in detail).
